title: Tailor Your Resume Like a Pro in 5 Minutes and Get Noticed
description:
Should you tailor your resume to a job description in order to land more interviews? Yes—but it doesn't have to take a ton of time. It's easier than it sounds—especially once you know what recruiters are looking for and what tools to use.
